permitted: Fetch NAV histories directly from asset management company websites that publish them publicly (polite bot, clear UA, rate-limited, cached, stops on 403/429)
Fetch the weekly open-end fund snapshot table from the LankaBangla Financial Portal for the fund universe and AUM metadata
Publish computed returns, dividends and fund metadata from those sources with attribution and per-fund data-status disclosure
attributionText: NAV data © the respective asset management companies. Fund universe snapshot from the LankaBangla Financial Portal (lankabd.com). Compiled and computed by Profithisab.
notes: No signed permission exists because none is required: every source is a first-party or public disclosure of NAV data (AMC websites publish their own funds' NAV; lankabd.com serves a public weekly table). permissionDate records the date this first-party fetching policy was adopted. ReturnKoto remains off-limits without written permission. The active source list, URLs and politeness rules live in data/sources.json; the fetcher is scripts/fetch-nav.ts.
